correctness.rationale: For the repaired maximal-set statement, the complement of the n-cycle has diameter two, so eligible sets are exactly those inducing no P3 in the complement, or a complete multipartite graph in the cycle. Among edge-containing sets the degree and triangle constraints allow only K2 or K1,2, since C_n has no induced C4 for n>=5. Every consecutive triple is maximal, and every cycle-edge pair extends to one. An independent set of size at least three can only extend independently, so exactly the maximal independent sets of that size survive. An independent maximal pair can only occur for n=5 or 6: independence and domination impose cyclic gaps 2 or 3, so the pair at n=5 has a gap of 2 and extends to a consecutive triple; the three such pairs at n=6 have two gaps of 3 and cannot extend. There are two maximal alternating independent triples at n=6. For any size k, the k-part circular gap list has n-2k gaps of length 3, giving n binom(k,n-2k)/k by rooting and unrooting on the labeled cycle. This gives the repaired full n>=5 census and lower-number consequence. The new checker, based on geodesic triple obstructions from Floyd distances, tests all legal subsets in ascending order and checks every possible extension for maximality, regardless of order. Its n=5..16 exact replay returned MAXIMAL_CENSUS_CHECK_OK; it corroborates, not replaces, the all-order proof.
residual_risks: Simple labeled cycle complements only. The finite check is not an all-order proof and makes no claim about other graph families, variants of general position, or maximality for proper non-geodesic notions.

originality.rationale: This verdict is for the repaired inclusion-maximal profile only. The strongest indexed comparator supplies the ordinary eligible-set structure, exact polynomial and strict log-concavity in a larger class: for H=C_n its edge and induced-P3 counts are n and its triangle and induced-C4 counts vanish. This is decisive coverage of the removed claims. The retained answer requires the maximality/containment comparison of eligible independent sets with eligible consecutive triples and yields the entire size-refined maximal general-position census. Known maximal independent counts and the universal-line criterion cover ingredients or numerical extremal aspects, not the inspected repaired exact profile. No inspected statement evaluates this profile. The assessment is bounded, and does not assert priority.
residual_risks: The retained facet classification is elementary after the eligible-set reduction. A publication or database under an independent-domination, facet-complex or universal-line formulation could already state the exact transfer; the bounded comparisons do not prove its absence.
Catalogue dates do not establish priority for either the removed or the retained work.

value.rationale: The size of an inclusion-maximal set is the size at which a greedy addition process can stop, not necessarily the largest feasible size. In the standard cycle-complement family the repaired theorem gives the exact labeled census for each possible terminal size, and identifies precisely how adding consecutive triples to the cycle's independence complex removes some previously maximal faces. In particular the six-cycle opposite-pair obstruction and the disappearance of the five-cycle pairs are explained, not inferred from a finite table. This is a natural complete classification addressing an established graph invariant, without re-claiming ordinary coefficient log-concavity or broad consequences for greedy algorithms.
residual_risks: Does not model a probability distribution over greedy stopping outputs; coefficients count labeled maximal solutions, not the number of insertion histories.
